rationale: The assistant misread the opener ('wont start', 'door is shut') as a door-won't-open problem and wasted the first turn on post-cycle lock timing, then in turn 2 gave a dubious explanation of dE as a 'Door/Drum Error' caused by load imbalance. Once the customer mentioned the duvet and the seal, it correctly identified that the bulky load was stopping the latch engaging, ran a sensible confirmation test (run without the duvet), and reached the right no-fault conclusion with no part or engineer pushed. Final advice to use a 'Bedding' cycle is only partly helpful since the real issue is capacity (launderette or smaller item), but the homeowner was ultimately well served.
